hooks.description: Blocks an Edit/Write the instant it introduces a confirmed schema-SHAPE violation (a new unclassified-PII column, a new table with no primary key, or a column narrowed/removed against the default branch's committed version) into a schema/migration file — the pure-logic half of this gate that needs no live Postgres. Data-profile checks (row counts, null rates, FK orphans, anomaly detection) still require a real database and stay CI-only. Same bypass mechanism as data-standards (TALEEMABAD_DATA_STANDARDS_BYPASS). See hooks/live-schema-shape-gate.py for exactly what can and cannot trip this.
